seo.title: Thank you: message received
seo.description: Your message has reached the right inbox at Calwebtech. Here is when to expect a reply and what happens to your details.

title: Thanks. Your message is with us.
intro: It is saved with the topic you chose, and a person on our team will read it. A confirmation email is on its way to the address you gave.

received.heading: What you sent us
items: The topic you chose, which decides the inbox it lands in
Your message, and your company if you added it

response.label: Expect a reply
response.detail: From a person who handles this kind of enquiry, by email or with a time for a short call if that is quicker.

steps.title: A person reads it
steps.body: Your message is read by someone who handles this kind of enquiry, not sorted by an autoresponder.

steps.title: We reply by email
steps.body: You get an answer, or a time for a short call if the question needs a conversation.

steps.title: Nothing else happens to your details
steps.body: Sending a message does not subscribe you to anything. We use your details only to answer you.

secondary.heading: Looking for something specific?
secondary.body: Most questions about price, timelines and ownership are already answered on our questions page.

image.alt: A project team planning a website with sticky notes on a whiteboard
